# CUXR

> CUXR (Cornell XR) is a student-led project team at Cornell University building extended reality software, haptic devices, and interactive experiences.

Founded in 2024, CUXR works across hardware, software, brain-computer interfaces, and game development. Contact: cuxr@cornell.edu.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cornellxr.com/): Team overview and featured projects.
- [Projects](https://cornellxr.com/projects/): Current and past projects in extended reality, haptics, and human-computer interaction.
- [Team](https://cornellxr.com/team/): Members, subteams, and alumni.
- [Recruitment](https://cornellxr.com/recruitment/): Application information, coffee chats, and info sessions. Consult this page for current dates and availability.
- [Sponsors](https://cornellxr.com/sponsor/): Ways to support the team and the sponsorship packet.
